# Sequence naming and schema (generated)

Generated by `automation/validate_sequence_schema.py`.

## Deterministic convention (combo family)

- Filename grammar: `sequence_combo_entry-<entry>_footer-<footer>_hero-<hero>_bottom-<bottom>_timer-<timer>.json`
- Canonical schema keys per file:
  - `combo`: fixed family id (`home_combo`)
  - `variant`: `entry-<entry>.footer-<footer>.hero-<hero>.bottom-<bottom>`
  - `dwell_band`: derived from `timer` (`dwell-none|dwell-single|dwell-stacked`)
  - `exit_mode`: derived from timer behavior (`exit-scroll|exit-back|exit-tap-dismiss`)
  - `ip_id_tail`: `tail-ipid` iff ending types are `rotate_identity -> wait -> full_reset`

## Allowed tokens

- `entry`: `direct` | `google_home`
- `footer`: `left` | `center` | `right`
- `hero`: `off` | `on`
- `bottom`: `left` | `center` | `right`
- `timer`: `none` | `single96` | `stacked`
